text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT — Post-deploy latency spike detected for runtime cluster r-us-west-2-03. Canary error rate up, and kernel fallback observed. Paging on-call.

samir: I’m on it. seeing 95th p99 jump to ~3.2s on canary slice, throughput dropped ~40%. Which deploy?

maria: rollout id: 2026.03.15-rl-v3. Kernel binary v2.1 landed in canary at 06:12 UTC. Logs show repeated "kernel fallback to cpu (OOM)" from a subset of pods.

ev an: quick note — GPU memory use spiked at ~95% immediately after batch size change. KV cache eviction frequency climbed.

lucy: tagging @ajohnson for a potential kill-switch. If it's the kernel build we should toggle the feature flag and shift traffic back to v2.0.

samir: agreed. @deploy-bot, can we flip the canary flag to block v2.1 kernels for r-us-west-2-03? Need immediate rollback path.

deploy-bot: Received command. Preparing runbook actions. Suggested mitigations: 1) disable kernel_v2_1_canary flag 2) reduce per-request batch_size from 32->8 3) shift canary traffic to previous model build v2.0.

maria: running quick scan for errors tied to batching vs kernel. If we reduce batch size we might relieve GPU memory pressure.

kevin: customer-impact telemetry — two customers hit 504s on the hosted API (tenant: acme-inc, tenant: bookstore-pro). Errors started at ~06:15 UTC. I'm escalating to support)
